items.title: Pfizer (PFE) Posts Phase 3 ELREXFIO Win And Expands AI Research Push
items.summary: Pfizer (NYSE:PFE) reported positive Phase 3 MagnetisMM-32 results for ELREXFIO in relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma after anti-CD38 therapy and lenalidomide. The MagnetisMM-32 trial evaluated ELREXFIO in patients whose disease had progressed following prior standard treatments, including anti-CD38 antibodies.
